subject: SIG: non-standard items — request for executive sign-off and exception statement

From: Ben Harper <security@fintrust.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire — items flagged as 'non-standard'

Hi Rafael / Marissa,

Thanks for returning the completed SIG spreadsheet last week. Our audit team has reviewed the responses and flagged three items as 'non-standard' for an organization at your maturity level: data retention for ephemeral logs, on-prem deployment roadmap commitment, and the KMS/HSM integration continuity plan.

For procurement to proceed we need either: (a) an executive-level exception statement describing compensating controls and a defined expiry, or (b) a firm roadmap commitment with target delivery quarter and product owner.

I've attached the annotated SIG with our comments (see attachment: SIG_questions_complete.xlsx). Happy to schedule a quick call this week to go over the findings.

Regards,
Ben Harper
Senior Information Security Manager
FinTrust Bank

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: responses and proposed exception language for FinTrust SIG items

Team — draft attached (SIG_nonstandard-draft.docx). High-level notes below. Please review and flag anything you can't support.

1) Ephemeral logs retention (Control ID: LOG-RET-07) — Current answer indicates 90 days retained for GPU inference logs; FinTrust prefers 365 days. Proposal: provide an exception for 12 months with continuous access via secure S3 bucket and monthly retention attestations + encrypted snapshots to a customer-controlled bucket upon request.

2) On-prem deployment roadmap (Control ID: DEP-ONP-02) — We do not have an immediate GA on-prem release; product roadmap commitment possible Q2 2027. Proposal: offer a formal roadmap commitment (target Q2 2027) with milestone checkpoints and a short-term managed VPC configuration as an interim solution.

3) KMS/HSM continuity (Control ID: KMS-INT-03) — Current implementation supports major KMS providers; FinTrust asked for HSM-backed key escrow workflows. Proposal: sign an exception with additional audit logging, quarterly key rotation evidence, and a product backlog ticket for HSM support.

Attachments: SIG_nonstandard-draft.docx (draft language and proposed controls).

If you agree, Rafael — please escalate to Michael for exec sign-off and include proposed exception expiry of 12 months.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft: responses and proposed exception language for FinTrust SIG items — request for exec decision

Michael — forwarding Marissa's draft. Quick summary and decision points:

- Item A (logs): propose temporary exception for 12 months with compensating controls (monthly attestations + encrypted snapshots to an S3 staging bucket).
- Item B (on-prem): product can commit to Q2 2027 roadmap delivery; interim managed VPC offering to close procurement gap.
- Item C (HSM): accept exception with enhanced audit logging + small backlog ticket to evaluate HSM export.

Ask: approve the exception language as-is and sign a short Statement_of_Exception (attached) OR direct changes. Procurement requires either signed exception doc or roadmap confirmation to proceed with contract finalization.

I included commercial notes below (karthik): potential 6–8 week delay if we insist on HSM before contract.

Thanks,
Rafael

- Signed doc: legal should send the Statement_of_Exception; we will sign and return to FinTrust. If FinTrust needs DocuSign, loop Sophie.

3) Jonas will upload the roadmap milestones to the Google Drive link below.
